reviews.title: Great value GPU
reviews.comment: People tend to have different opinions about the AMD 6500xt, but for me, I wanted a card that worked and the could handle some light gaming and graphic design. It works perfectly and the size fits great in my M-atx build. For best performance, you will have to have a motherboard with PCIE-4. If you're one of those hard gore gamers who want to run triple A titles on max settings, don't get this card. But for entry level graphical tasks, this is a pretty good little card.
reviews.author: Johnny M.
